content.title: Recycling & Trash
content.summary: The City of Arvada collaborates with Republic Services to provide recycling and trash services, offering four service levels with monthly fees ranging from $6.24 to $22.45 starting July 1, 2025. Residents can also request additional services such as extra trash or recycling carts and bulky item pickups for additional charges. For missed pickups or service changes, residents should contact Republic Services at 720-898-7575.
content.body:
## City of Arvada Waste Hauling Program

The City partners with Republic Services to offer recycling and trash services. For **missed waste and recycling pick up, to request new service or change your current service level,**please call 720-898-7575.

### Program Rates

The City's program offers four service levels to suit your waste generation habits. These rates are monthly but billed in your [bi-monthly water and recycling / trash bill](/453/Pay-My-Bill).

These costs are largely passed directly to Republic Services. A small portion funds the [bulky item](/728) and [leaf recycling](/718) drop-off events. These events are included as a part of the minimum services and are available to all Arvada residents.

| Service Level | Monthly fee beginning July 1, 2025 |
| --- | --- |
| **Level 3** 95 gallon trash cart 95 gallon recycling cart | $22.45 / month |
| **Level 2** 65 gallon trash cart  95 gallon recycling cart | $17.87 / month |
| **Level 1** 35 gallon trash cart 95 gallon recycling cart | $13.29 / month |
| **Minimum service** No cart, choose your own hauler (bulky item and leaf drop-off included) | $6.24 / month |
July 2025 - June 2026 Waste Hauling Program Rates

| Additional Services | Fees beginning July 1, 2025 |
| --- | --- |
| Additional Recycling Cart | $3.09 / month |
| Additional Trash Cart | $4.66 / month |
| Tags for Extra Trash Bags (details below) | $3.75 / tag |
| Bulky Item Pick Up (details below) | $16.82 |
| Waste Roll-off (one per contract year)\* | $305.07 |
| Green Waste / Compost Roll-off (one per contract year)\* | $415.77 |
July 2025 - June 2026 Waste Hauling Program Additional Services Rates

\*Please contact Republic Services for **more information about roll-off services at 720-590-4334.**

Visit the [Republic Services/Arvada customer site](https://www.republicservices.com/municipality/arvada-co) for more resources.

## Additional Service Details

1. [Find Your Service Day](#tab1957ddcd-31b8-479b-b9d8-0cc45c7c1092_0)

View a [searchable map](https://arvada.maps.arcgis.com/apps/instant/sidebar/index.html?appid=6216d78359d8476a85906e303197fdcb) to find your collection day and recycling week color. PDF calendars for each day/recycling week are available on the [Republic Services / Arvada website](https://www.republicservices.com/municipality/arvada-co/resources#calendar).

If your service day falls on or after the holiday, you will experience a 1-day delay in service. If the holiday falls on a weekend, there will be no delay in service. The following holidays are observed:

- New Year's Day
- Memorial Day
- 4th of July
- Labor Day
- Thanksgiving Day
- Christmas Day

1. [Extra Bag tags](#tab1957ddcd-31b8-479b-b9d8-0cc45c7c1092_1)

If you have more waste than can fit in the cart you can purchase tags for extra bags and have this waste picked up during your regular service. Bag tags can be purchased at City Hall (8101 Ralston Road) or call 720-898-7070 for more information.  Extra bags without tags will not be picked up.

\*Please bring the exact amount in cash or pay by check. **Change cannot be provided.**

1. [Bulky Item Pick Up](#tab1957ddcd-31b8-479b-b9d8-0cc45c7c1092_2)

Residents who participate in the City's waste-hauling service can have oversized items that do not fit in carts picked up during regular trash pick up for an additional charge. [View a list of acceptable and unacceptable items](/1368). **Call 720-898-7575 for more information, current rates, and to coordinate service.**

1. [Recycling Guide](#tab1957ddcd-31b8-479b-b9d8-0cc45c7c1092_3)

For questions about acceptable recycling materials, what can go in your waste cart, and other service details access this [Service Guide (PDF)](https://www.republicservices.com/cms/documents/municipality/ARVADA-CO/Arvada-Colorado-Service-Guide.pdf#page=3). You can download the guide and find other resources on our Republic Services/Arvada [resources page](https://www.republicservices.com/municipality/arvada-co/resources).

**Republic Services App:**If you'd like to use the Republic Services app you will need to call the team at 720-898-7575 and get your account number directly from Republic. Please note: this is different than your City utilities customer number that is on your City water and trash bill.

1. [Service Level Changes](#tab1957ddcd-31b8-479b-b9d8-0cc45c7c1092_4)

If you would like to make a service level change including changing cart sizes, requesting minimum service or setting up new service, please call 720-898-7575.

There is **no charge** for:

- Service level changes, including cart swaps (once per year).
- Removal of City of Arvada carts for residents who wish to hire their own hauler.
- Delivering additional waste or recycling carts.

If you need to make a change to your service with the City of Arvada Waste and Recycling Program, please contact the team at 720-898-7575.

1. [Hard to Recycle Items](#tab1957ddcd-31b8-479b-b9d8-0cc45c7c1092_5)

## Hard to recycle items

The City maintains partnerships with [Rooney Road](https://www.rooneyroadrecycling.org/) and [Sustainability](https://www.sustainability-recycling.com/) recycling centers to help Arvada residents properly dispose of hazardous waste and hard to recycle items.

### Cart Placement and Storagecart placement should have 3 feet of spacing between objects and overhead clearance should be at least 4 feet.

[Arvada Municipal Code Chapter 18, Sect. 18-517](https://library.municode.com/co/arvada/codes/code_of_ordinances?nodeId=PTIICOOR_CH18BUBURE_ARTXIINPRMACO_S18-517I.SE308.5REAR) requires trash and recycling containers to be stored behind the front plane of a residence when not placed out for collection. Appropriate places to store your containers are on the side of your house, in a garage, or in the back or side yard.

- Containers should be placed out by 7 am on your collection day.
- Containers should be placed as close to curbside as possible without obstructing the sidewalk.
- Municipal Code requires that containers may not be curbside for longer than 24 consecutive hours per week.

### [FAQs](/Faq.aspx?TID=69)

[What services are included in the City’s waste & recycling program?](#)
:   - Weekly trash collection. There are three cart sizes to suit your needs.
    - Biweekly recycling collection with a 95 gallon cart. You may add additional recycle carts for an additional charge.
    - Drop off events, including bulky item, leaf recycling and yard waste events for all Arvada residents who participate in the program at any level, including minimum service level.
    - On-demand curbside bulky item pick up for an additional fee for households with cart service.
    - Door-to-curb services for physically impaired residents on request.

    Services are monthly but billed as a part of your bi-monthly water and trash bill. **Call 720-898-7575** to request new service or change your current service level.

[How do I find my trash pickup day?](#)
:   Reference this online [map of service days](https://arvada.maps.arcgis.com/apps/instant/sidebar/index.html?appid=6216d78359d8476a85906e303197fdcb) or visit the [Republic website for a printable version](https://www.republicservices.com/municipality/arvada-co/resources#map).

[Are trash and recycling services delayed for holidays?](#)
:   Yes, if your service day falls on or after the holidays below, you will experience a 1-day delay in service. If the holiday falls on a weekend, there will be no delay in service. The following holidays are observed:

    - New Year's Day
    - Memorial Day
    - 4th of July
    - Labor Day
    - Thanksgiving Day
    - Christmas Day

[How do I purchase bag tags for additional bags that don't fit in my cart?](#)
:   There are two options available:

    1. Purchase extra “bag tags” for any bags that do not fit into your waste cart. You can purchase bag tags at City Hall (8101 Ralston Road) or call 720-898-7070 for more information.

       \*Please bring the exact amount in cash or pay by check. Change cannot be provided.
    2. Add an additional waste cart to your plan. If you choose Service Level 3 (95 gallon waste cart), you can add additional cart for a small monthly fee. It may be less expensive to have an extra cart. 95 gallon carts hold 7 to 8 tall kitchen bags.

    Residents are also encouraged to consider leaving grass clippings on the lawn for healthier grass. Leaves can also be mulched and left on the lawn.

[How do I change cart sizes or add an additional cart?](#)
:   Residents can change their service level (bigger or smaller carts) once per year for free. Additional service level changes in a one year period will incur a $15 fee for cart delivery. Additional carts can be added to your current service level for a small additional cost. Current costs are available on the [Trash & Recycling page](https://www.arvadaco.gov/715/Trash-Recycling).

    Please call Republic at 720-898-7575 to coordinate either changes or additional carts.

[Are there start up fees or additional fees?](#)
:   No, there are no startup, administrative or fuel fees for residents joining the program. The service level fees published are what you will pay for your selected service level. The fees listed are monthly. They will appear on your bi-monthly City of Arvada utility bill. You may change your service level once per year for no additional fee.

    Additional services (such as on-demand curbside bulky item pick up, additional waste or recycling carts and bag tags for extra bags of trash) are available for additional fees should you choose to use them.

[If I join the City’s program and I don’t like it, can I switch to minimum service?](#)
:   The City’s waste hauling contract includes a 99.9% service guarantee and penalties for poor service or non-compliance. Our aim is to provide residents of Arvada with high-quality, worry-free waste and recycling collection service. But, if the program turns out to not suit your household, you may change to the minimum service level and pay the associated monthly fee.

    You can change service levels once per year at no additional charge.

[Am I required to recycle?](#)
:   The organized waste hauling ordinance calls for all eligible households to have access to curbside recycling. That means having a recycling cart is an important part of the program and a recycling cart will be provided to all households. Other haulers are likewise now required to offer customers with recycling options.

    Customer Service staff are available to assist you in learning how to recycle. No one will be forced to place their recycle cart out for collection.

[Does the City provide alley pick up when a house backs to an alley?](#)
:   Yes, the City’s program provides alley service. To verify alley pick up at your exact address, please contact the Customer Service Line at 720-898-7575.

[I sold my house and am moving out. What do I need to do to end my waste and recycling service?](#)
:   The City will handle trash service the same way they currently transfer water service when a house is sold. Leave the carts at the property. Provide information to your title company when they request it. Once the new owner takes possession, they can change their service level by calling the Customer Service Line for Arvada at 720-898-7575.

[Do I have to pay the Minimum Service Level fee if I do not intend to use the service?](#)
:   Yes, the program is intended to provide benefits to the entire community and all residents pay into the program with or without cart service. Residents who choose a different hauler still have access to City program's annual bulky item and fall leaf drop off events.

    The City did negotiate a lower minimum service rate for residents that choose to hire a different hauler. Most other cities have higher minimum service rates.

[What does the Minimum Service Level fee fund?](#)
:   The Minimum Service Level fee is distributed in two ways. The majority of the fee is passed directly to the contracted waste hauler, Republic Services. A smaller portion of the fee goes to the City to help fund the bulky item and leaf recycling drop off events, billing services employees, and related billing systems.

[What happens if I refuse to pay the Minimum Service fee?](#)
:   While your water service will remain uninterrupted, non-payment of the Residential Waste and Recycling Program monthly minimum service fee may result in a lien placed on your property.

[Where can I take recycling to drop off?](#)
:   Arvada does not have a recycling drop-off location. Arvada's municipal code requires all licensed waste haulers in Arvada to provide curbside recycling services. Please contact your waste hauler to request curbside recycling.

    The City's [waste hauling program](/715) includes curbside recycling services at no additional cost.

    Some items cannot be recycled in curbside (single stream) recycling. The City maintains partnerships with [Rooney Road Recycling Center](https://www.rooneyroadrecycling.org/) and [SustainAbility](https://www.sustainability-recycling.com/) for disposing of household hazardous waste and hard to recycle items. Please check their websites for more information about cost and accepted items.
